name: Transcribe using online mode and edit the result
description: Verifies the online mode sends an imported audio recording to the hosted transcription endpoint and displays editable transcript text.
expected: The app shows section progress and the returned transcript appears in the editor, or a visible connection/service error appears while manual editing remains available.

name: Transcribe on-device without sending audio to the cloud
description: Verifies the user can choose on-device Whisper mode for local transcription after the model is available.
expected: The app shows local model progress and an editable transcript or a visible model/audio error.

name: Save, search, export, and delete a library transcript
description: Verifies a transcript can be saved to local browser storage, found in the library, exported, and deleted.
steps: Transcribe or type text for an audio recording
Open Library and search for part of the recording name
expected: The saved transcript appears in search, export starts, and the deleted item no longer appears.

name: Read text aloud with Voice Studio controls
description: Verifies text can be entered into Voice Studio and played or stopped using browser speech synthesis.
steps: Tap Read aloud and then Stop reading
expected: The browser starts speaking the entered text when speech synthesis is available and the stop control cancels playback.

name: Show a helpful error when transcription cannot run
description: Verifies a failed model download or unsupported audio is explained and manual editing remains available.
steps: Choose a supported but unreadable or unsupported audio recording
Tap a transcription mode and transcribe
Read the error and enter transcript text manually
expected: A visible error message explains the problem and the transcript editor remains usable.
